say:1:1530360001:1.text: The man who's always with me, selling stuff.
say:1:1530360001:1.source_cn: 就是总和我在一起，卖东西的那个。
say:1:1530360001:1.male: The man who's always with me, selling stuff.
say:1:1530360001:1.female: The man who's always with me, selling stuff.

say:2:1530360002:1.text: He went out to rescue people a few days ago and never came back.
say:2:1530360002:1.source_cn: 他前几天说要去救人，可一直也没回来。
say:2:1530360002:1.male: He went out to rescue people a few days ago and never came back.
say:2:1530360002:1.female: He went out to rescue people a few days ago and never came back.

say:3:1530360003:1.text: God of Harvest, please keep him safe.
say:3:1530360003:1.source_cn: 丰饶神保佑，他可不要出什么事情啊。
say:3:1530360003:1.male: God of Harvest, please keep him safe.
say:3:1530360003:1.female: God of Harvest, please keep him safe.
